prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original panoramic background artwork for Eurozone, a browser farming board game. Primary request: a refined, warm hand-painted European farming board-game illustration, evoking traditional Agricola-like pastoral board-game art through pen-and-ink and gouache on subtly textured cream paper. A late seventeenth-century central European farmstead: timber farmhouse and barn, vegetable plots and golden grain fields, small sheep pasture, fruit trees, rolling hills. Wide landscape composition, richly illustrated borders and scenery around a calm open meadow through the center, so game boards can sit over it. Natural earthy colors: wheat gold, terracotta, sage green, warm brown, parchment. Fine ink lines, beautiful restrained detail, tactile printed-board quality, inviting daylight. Original composition and original buildings. Image only, no words, no lettering, no logos, no slogans, no interface elements, no cards or board grid, no photorealism, no glossy 3D. Landscape wide aspect ratio.
description: Original generated farmstead illustration; distinct from imported Agricola board and card scans.
